ram.basis: 320 KB of on-chip SRAM (ESP32-S2), minus the 64,800-byte full framebuffer, minus a 128 KB reserve for the SDK and its stacks. Derived from the datasheet, never measured on this board.

provenance.note: unverified against silicon. Panel (1.14 inch IPS, 240x135, ST7789), MCU (ESP32-S2 at 240MHz, 4MB flash, 2MB PSRAM) and the button complement are read off Adafruit's own product page. The 320 KB SRAM figure is the ESP32-S2's, from Espressif, not from that page. ONE button is declared, and that is the point of this silhouette: the board carries exactly two tactile buttons, RESET and BOOT0/D0, and RESET is not readable by an app, so it is not declared at all rather than declared as a control that does nothing. There is no IMU on this board, which is why its sensors array is empty rather than optimistic. Do not confuse this board with the ESP32-S2 Reverse TFT Feather (product 5345), which has three user buttons and would answer a different question.
